final: WITH country_averages AS (SELECT p.death_country, AVG(1.0 * v.points_won / v.points_max) AS avg_ratio FROM player_award_vote AS v JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id = v.player_id GROUP BY p.death_country), overall_average AS (SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS overall_avg FROM country_averages) SELECT c.death_country, c.avg_ratio, c.avg_ratio / o.overall_avg AS ratio_to_overall FROM country_averages AS c CROSS JOIN overall_average AS o WHERE o.overall_avg IS NOT NULL
